newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close up on buying of bank stocks.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close up on buying of bank stocks.

text.p: The Thai stock market, which moved in a narrow range throughout Thursday, rallied in the last 30 seconds as local retailers bought big capitalised banking issues, brokers said.
"Investors bought large capitalised banking stocks such as Bangkok Bank, Krung Thai, Thai Farmers and Siam Commercial just before the market closed," said a broker at Asia Credit.

The SET index moved sluggishly throughout the day due to a lack of fresh and positive news to boost investment. It ended 4.55 points higher at 749.14 on 2.3 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index advanced 0.39 point to 54.89.
